arabic text: YE SHAME GARIBAN HAI, DARIYA KI RAWANI HAI\nPYASE NA RAHE BAKI PHIR KISLIYE PAANI HAI
english translation text: This is the night of desolation; the river still flows.\nWhen none of the thirsty remain alive, what purpose does the water serve?

arabic text: (ASGER TERE LASHE KO MAA BAN KE ZAMIN RAKHE)\n(UJRI HUWI GODI KI)\nMASUM NISHANI HAI
english translation text: O earth, cradle Asghar’s body like a mother;\nhe is the innocent remnant\nof a mother’s emptied lap.

arabic text: (KHUN KAISE RUKE LOGO AKBER KA JAWANI MAI)\n(AI KHUN NAYA LEKIN)\nBARCHI KO PURANI HAI
english translation text: How can Akbar’s blood be stopped in the prime of youth?\nThe blood is fresh,\nbut the spear is old.

arabic text: (MALUM NA THA SHEH KO KHUD APNE HI HATHOSE)\n(SHABBAR KI NISHANI BHI)\nMATI ME MILANI HAI
english translation text: The King did not know that with his own hands\nhe would have to place Shabbar’s remembrance—Qasim—\nbeneath the soil.

arabic text: (SHABBIR KO KHANJAR SE ZYAAD AA YE AZIYAT HAI)\n(TAKLIF JO ZINDAN ME)\nBACHI KO UTHANI HAI
english translation text: More painful to Shabbir than the dagger itself\nis the suffering\nhis little daughter must endure in prison.

arabic text: (ZAINAB NE KAHA THERO ME DASHT ME AATI HU)\n(BHAYA TUME AKBER KI)\nAB LAASH UTHANI HAI
english translation text: Zainab said, ‘Wait—I am coming into the desert.\nBrother, we must now lift\nAkbar’s body.’
